revision.description: Set at registration; revision n+1 for an edit.

timezone.description: IANA zone for every time in the file.

last_night.description: The last group night the rules allow.

prize_scope.description: One prize per person across this scope.

sources.description: Named ops sources routes; sha + count + as_of are kept on every step that reads one.

from.description: The ops sources route name (never SQL).

settle_gate.description: The read that `X settled` waits for.

late.description: What happens when the step runs past its time: hold (stop, alert, wait for a person), late_copy (switch to the message's `late` variant), run (draws), skip (only if declared).

grace.description: How long after due_at before the step counts as late (A1).

after_that.description: After the late copy's own window has passed.

message.description: One approved email: Casey's words, its own metric and its own one-email flow.

sha256.description: The approved copy sha256; `observed` for a message only the Mac or the review sender sends; filled by `seqctl check --fill`.

campaign_name.description: For an observed Mac message: its exact Klaviyo campaign name, with {night} and {n} fills.

flow.description: For an observed review-sender message: its Klaviyo flow id.

says.description: Time words in the copy and the wall-clock window each is true in.

late.description: The message used past the says-window (its own metric and flow).

promises.description: Customer promises the plan must keep.

needs.description: The step that makes it true.

do_assert.description: Preconditions that fail closed (dependents hold, A8).

id.description: Short snake_case step id, unique in the sequence.

anyOf.description: A step id, optionally followed by ' settled' (the step reached its settle gate).

items.description: A step id, optionally followed by ' settled' (the step reached its settle gate).

after.description: Steps that must meet their target first (or end partial with on_partial: continue).

when.description: A guard on upstream outputs, e.g. "promote.alternate != null".

at.description: When the step is due, in the sequence's timezone: 'night+N HH:MM[:SS]', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', '<step>.first_post + 24h' or '<instant> + N days HH:MM:SS'.
